rows.grounds: pañcama-pratimiti (substitute for the fifth element) in instrumental with ayam fused by sandhi
pañcamakāra-pratimiti, instrumental of the substitute for the fifth makāra
dakṣiṇa-āmnāya-siddhi-da, compound denoting one who grants accomplishment of the southern tradition

items.question: How does substitution for the fifth makāra grant accomplishment in the southern tradition?
premises: The practice employs a substitute for the fifth element.
This substitute is specifically for the fifth makāra.
The result is accomplishment within the southern tradition.
items.inference: Therefore, using the substitute for the fifth makāra confers accomplishment in the southern tradition.
uncertainties: The exact referent of ayam within the fused token is contextually implied rather than explicit.
items.plain_english: By this substitute for the fifth makāra, the practice grants accomplishment in the southern tradition.
